panels.title: Health Overview
panels.description: Core health indicators - if everything is green here, your system is healthy

panels.title: Error Rates (SLO)
panels.description: Error rates for API endpoints and oneshot pipelines. Should be <1% for healthy operation.

panels.title: Latency p95 (SLO)
panels.description: 95th percentile latency for API requests and oneshot pipelines. Lower is better.

panels.title: Process Health
panels.description: Skit process CPU and memory usage. High CPU or memory growth indicates resource constraints.

panels.title: Active Components
panels.description: Current active sessions, engine nodes, and WebSocket connections.

panels.title: HTTP API
panels.description: HTTP server performance and request handling

panels.title: HTTP Request Rate
panels.description: Total HTTP requests per second across all endpoints.

panels.title: HTTP Status Mix
panels.description: Distribution of HTTP status codes for API routes (/api/*). Watch for increases in 4xx or 5xx.

panels.title: HTTP Latency Percentiles
panels.description: HTTP request duration percentiles. p50 = median, p95/p99 = tail latency.

panels.title: Engine & Data Plane
panels.description: Pipeline execution performance and backpressure

panels.title: Node Throughput
panels.description: Aggregate packet processing rate across all nodes. Shows pipeline activity.

panels.title: Node Errors & Drops
panels.description: Processing errors and discarded packets. Should be near zero for healthy operation.

panels.title: Pin Distributor Backpressure
panels.description: Time spent waiting for downstream capacity. High values indicate bottlenecks.

panels.title: Best-Effort Drops
panels.description: Packets dropped on best-effort connections due to slow consumers.

panels.title: Video Pipeline
panels.description: Video encoding, decoding, and compositor health

panels.title: Video Encode Duration p95
panels.description: 95th percentile encode time per frame. The red threshold at 33.3ms is the frame budget at 30fps — exceeding it means the encoder cannot keep up with real-time.

panels.title: Video Pipeline Health
panels.description: Frames where encoding exceeded the frame budget (A/V desync risk) and compositor frame drops. Both should be zero during healthy operation.

panels.title: Video Decode Duration p95
panels.description: 95th percentile decode time per frame. The red threshold at 33.3ms is the frame budget at 30fps.

panels.title: Plugins / ML inference
panels.description: Native ML plugin (STT/TTS/translation) FFI call performance and lifecycle

panels.title: Plugin Inference Latency by Kind
panels.description: FFI call duration percentiles per plugin kind. Tail latency (p95/p99) drives request latency for hosted speech services.

panels.title: Plugin Call Rate by Kind/Op
panels.description: FFI calls per second, split by plugin kind and operation.

panels.title: Plugin Failure Rate by Kind
panels.description: Errors + timeouts + panics per second by plugin kind (stacked). Stack total is the overall failure rate.

panels.title: Models Loaded
panels.description: Currently loaded plugins by type (native ML models + WASM).

panels.title: Plugin Load/Unload Rate
panels.description: Plugin load and unload operations per second by type.

panels.title: Speech Gateway
panels.description: examples/speech-gateway Go front-end metrics (gateway_* contract). No data until the gateway is running and scraped.

panels.title: Gateway Request Rate by Endpoint
panels.description: Requests per second handled by the gateway, by endpoint.

panels.title: Gateway Status Mix
panels.description: Share of responses by status code. Watch for rising 4xx/5xx.

panels.title: Gateway Latency p95 by Endpoint
panels.description: p95 request duration per endpoint.

panels.title: Gateway In-flight Requests
panels.description: Concurrent in-flight requests per endpoint.

panels.title: Gateway Upstream vs Total p95
panels.description: Upstream (StreamKit) p95 vs total gateway p95 per endpoint. Gap is gateway-side overhead.

panels.title: Gateway Rejections by Reason
panels.description: Rejected requests per second by reason (e.g. rate limit, payload too large).

panels.title: Oneshot Speech Services
panels.description: Per-service split of oneshot pipeline metrics via the `service` label (tts/stt/other). Requires the service label on oneshot_pipeline_duration.

panels.title: Oneshot Latency p95 by Service
panels.description: p95 oneshot pipeline duration by service (tts/stt/other).

panels.title: Oneshot Error Rate by Service
panels.description: Percentage of oneshot pipelines ending in error, by service.

panels.title: MoQ Transport Throughput
panels.description: Packet rates for MoQ transport nodes (peer/subscriber/publisher).

panels.title: MoQ Transport (Advanced)
panels.description: Media over QUIC transport metrics - collapsed by default

panels.title: Top Node Types by Packets Sent
panels.description: Top 10 node types by total packets sent (aggregated by node kind).

panels.title: Per-Node Details (Advanced)
panels.description: Deep-dive into individual node performance

panels.title: Pacer Lateness p95
panels.description: Audio pacing lateness (95th percentile). Shows timing drift.

panels.title: Pin Distributor Queue Depth (seconds)
panels.description: Estimated backlog in media seconds at pin distributors.

panels.title: Pacer Queue Depth
panels.description: Pacer buffered packet count.

panels.title: MoQ Push Clock Offset p95
panels.description: Offset between outgoing MoQ timestamp and upstream packet timestamp.

panels.title: MoQ Peer Inter-frame Gap p95
panels.description: Gap between consecutive frames sent to subscribers.

panels.title: Timing & Queue Depths (Advanced)
panels.description: Detailed timing and queue metrics

panels.title: Opus Codec Performance
panels.description: Opus p95 duration per packet (left axis, typical: 1-10ms) and processing throughput (right axis).

panels.title: MP3 Codec Performance
panels.description: MP3 p95 decode duration per packet (left axis) and processing throughput (right axis).

panels.title: FLAC Codec Performance
panels.description: FLAC p95 decode duration per packet (left axis) and processing throughput (right axis).

panels.title: WAV Container Performance
panels.description: WAV p95 demux duration per packet (left axis) and processing throughput (right axis).

panels.title: Codecs (Advanced)
panels.description: Audio codec and container performance metrics

title: StreamKit Performance Dashboard
description: Streamlined operational dashboard focusing on high-signal health indicators. Expanded rows show core metrics, collapsed rows provide deep-dive debugging.
